# NARA M31 roll 14 - Anthony Morris code passages. First-pass transcription, made BEFORE decoding.
# Frames 124-125 (+ plain 126) are one copy; 191-192 + top of 193 (+ plain 193) are another copy of the SAME text.
# 191 and 192 are NOT copies of each other: 192 continues 191 ("...is made the / more 1570 by what...").
#
# Notation
#   .       the writer's own stop. Spacing is ignored; dots are as written.
#   ?       doubtful digit, or (as 1234?) doubtful group
#   [c]     C-like hook under the figure
#   [3] [5] 3-like / 5-like stroke under the figure (repeat = several strokes: [55], [5555])
#   <       small angle after the group
#   ^       small triangle / caret after the group
#   | ... | ordinary English in the line (not coded)
#   catch:  catchword at foot of page
# Line ids: frame.line; 125R and 192R = right-hand page of the spread.
# In both copies digits are written with long descenders on 7 and 9; 1 often joined to the next digit, so 10-/14- are confusable.
